name: Ziffr operations
summary: The figures of the Usage Feed as Metrics, with a dashboard: people, Workspaces, signups, trials, values by Source, calls and views. For whoever runs a Ziffr Installation.

setUp.line: The daily figures of your Ziffr Installation. Counts only.
happens: A program sends the counts once a day
The dashboard shows people, Workspaces, signups, values and calls
needs: An Installation Admin, who makes the Usage Key
A Feed with a Feed Key in this Workspace

whatItsFor.text: For whoever runs a Ziffr Installation. A program sends the counts once a day, and a dashboard shows people, Workspaces, signups, trials, values, calls and views. Counts only.

items: A **Feed** with a Feed Key in the Workspace for these figures.
An **Installation Admin**, who makes the Usage Key and puts it and the Feed Key into the Installation's settings.
Room for 36 Metrics in your Workspace.

questions.text: Why is a figure empty or always 0?
Splits are held back while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces. A few figures are not recorded yet and read 0 or stay empty; the usage guide lists them.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Workspaces
metric.description: Workspaces on the Installation at the end of the day.
metric.calculationNote: Every Workspace except the demo and the one the Installation Admin leaves out of the figures.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Workspaces: trial
metric.description: Workspaces in a trial at the end of the day. Held back while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces.
metric.calculationNote: Workspaces whose trial has an end date and that have not been kept. Left out while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces behind the figure.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Workspaces: free
metric.description: Workspaces on the free size at the end of the day. Held back while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces.
metric.calculationNote: All counted Workspaces less those in a trial and those on a paid size. Left out while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces behind the figure.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Workspaces: paid
metric.description: Workspaces on a paid size at the end of the day. Held back while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces.
metric.calculationNote: Workspaces outside a trial that have a Workspace Limit set for them. Left out while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces behind the figure.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: People
metric.description: People with an account at the end of the day.
metric.calculationNote: People with an account who are members of at least one counted Workspace, each counted once. Contacts and Feeds are not counted.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: People: active 7d
metric.description: People who used Ziffr in the 7 days up to the end of the day.
metric.calculationNote: People who signed in during the seven days up to the end of the day. Someone who stayed signed in from earlier is not counted.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Workspaces: active 7d
metric.description: Workspaces where something happened in the 7 days up to the end of the day.
metric.calculationNote: Counted Workspaces that were last used within the seven days up to the end of the day.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Metrics
metric.description: Metrics across all Workspaces at the end of the day.
metric.calculationNote: Metrics that are not archived, in all counted Workspaces.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Metrics: archived
metric.description: Archived Metrics across all Workspaces at the end of the day.
metric.calculationNote: Archived Metrics in all counted Workspaces. They are not part of the figure for Metrics.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Dashboards
metric.description: Dashboards across all Workspaces at the end of the day.
metric.calculationNote: All dashboards of the counted Workspaces.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Widgets
metric.description: Widgets on dashboards at the end of the day.
metric.calculationNote: Widgets placed on a dashboard. Widgets saved to be used again and widgets on slides are not counted.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Decks
metric.description: Decks across all Workspaces at the end of the day.
metric.calculationNote: All decks of the counted Workspaces.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Workflows
metric.description: Workflows across all Workspaces at the end of the day.
metric.calculationNote: All Workflows of the counted Workspaces, whether or not a Metric uses them.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Feeds
metric.description: Feeds across all Workspaces at the end of the day.
metric.calculationNote: Feeds that have not been deleted.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Packs installed
metric.description: Installed Packs across all Workspaces at the end of the day.
metric.calculationNote: Installed Packs added up over all counted Workspaces, so a Pack in five Workspaces counts five times.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Workspaces created
metric.description: Workspaces created in the period.
metric.calculationNote: Workspaces made on that day, in UTC. One deleted again before the figures were taken is not counted.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Trials started
metric.description: Trials started in the period.
metric.calculationNote: Workspaces whose trial began on that day, in UTC.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Trials kept
metric.description: Trials that turned into a Workspace kept in the period.
metric.calculationNote: Trials kept on that day, in UTC.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Trials closed
metric.description: Trials that ended without being kept in the period.
metric.calculationNote: Trials closed on that day, in UTC.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Sizes booked
metric.description: Times a Workspace booked a size in the period.
metric.calculationNote: Each time Ziffr Cloud set or changed the size of a Workspace on that day, in UTC. Limits an Installation Admin sets by hand are not counted.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Workspaces deleted
metric.description: Workspaces deleted in the period.
metric.calculationNote: Workspaces deleted on that day, in UTC.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Signups
metric.description: People who signed up in the period.
metric.calculationNote: People whose account was made on that day and who belong to a counted Workspace.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Values: web
metric.description: Values that arrived through the web form in the period. Held back while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces.
metric.calculationNote: Values recorded that day through the web form. Left out while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces behind the figure.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Values: email
metric.description: Values that arrived by email in the period. Held back while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces.
metric.calculationNote: Values recorded that day by email. Left out while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces behind the figure.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Values: Slack
metric.description: Values that arrived through Slack in the period. Held back while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces.
metric.calculationNote: Values recorded that day through Slack. Left out while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces behind the figure.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Values: Telegram
metric.description: Values that arrived through Telegram in the period. Held back while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces.
metric.calculationNote: Values recorded that day through Telegram. Left out while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces behind the figure.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Values: API
metric.description: Values that arrived through the API in the period. Held back while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces.
metric.calculationNote: Values recorded that day with a person’s Access Key, a local MCP Server included. Left out while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces behind the figure.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Values: Feed
metric.description: Values that arrived through a Feed in the period. Held back while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces.
metric.calculationNote: Values recorded that day with a Feed Key. Left out while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces behind the figure.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Values: MCP
metric.description: Values that arrived through the MCP server in the period. Held back while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces.
metric.calculationNote: Values recorded that day by a connected assistant. Left out while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces behind the figure.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: API calls
metric.description: Calls to the API in the period.
metric.calculationNote: Calls to the API counted on that day, in UTC.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Feed calls
metric.description: Calls made with a Feed Key in the period.
metric.calculationNote: Calls made with a Feed Key, counted on that day, in UTC. Left out while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces behind the figure.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: MCP calls
metric.description: Calls to the MCP server in the period.
metric.calculationNote: Calls by connected assistants to the MCP Server, counted on that day, in UTC. Left out while the Installation has fewer than three Workspaces behind the figure.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Emails sent
metric.description: Emails Ziffr sent in the period.
metric.calculationNote: Emails from the Outbox that were sent on that day, in UTC. Emails that wait or failed are not counted.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Views: dashboards
metric.description: Dashboard views in the period.
metric.calculationNote: How often dashboards were opened that day, by signed-in people and through View Links. Reads by programs are not counted.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Views: decks
metric.description: Deck views in the period.
metric.calculationNote: How often decks were opened that day, by signed-in people and through View Links. Reads by programs are not counted.

comesFrom.note: Ziffr's Usage Feed is the program for this. Someone who runs scheduled jobs sets it up.

metric.name: Views: metrics
metric.description: Metric page views in the period.
metric.calculationNote: How often a Metric’s page was opened that day by signed-in people. Reads by programs are not counted.
